meta.title: Evgeny Chesnokov — C++/Qt developer
meta.description: Senior C++/Qt developer from Saint Petersburg. Specializing in QML and UI/UX. KDE contributor.

wip: // site under construction — still polishing things

hero.eyebrow: now in Saint Petersburg · feel free to write
hero.name: Evgeny
hero.sub: Six years writing desktop interfaces in C++ and Qt — and I'm still not tired of it. These days I build system utilities for a Russian OS, and a chunk of my work hours goes to KDE. Yes, open source on company time — I still can't quite believe it myself.

about.p1: I first met programming at university, but it didn't click right away. In my third year I did an internship at RNIIRS — started by poking at kernel modules, then made my way to Qt. A year later my mentor from that same internship invited me onto his team to build QML interfaces. That's how it all began, in April 2019.
about.p2: Qt wasn't an ideological pick — more like a happy coincidence. I honestly tried other things: took a Python course, dug into Dart + Flutter (even passed a couple of mid-level interviews), peeked at JS — it feels familiar because it shows up so much in QML. But there are so many JS frameworks that I never figured out where to start, and I happily stayed with Qt. No regrets.
about.p3: What I love most about the work is UI/UX and the way people interact with software. It matters to me that a program isn't just functional but actually pleasant — that the person opening it feels everything is in its right place.

projects.desc: Most of my open-source work goes through KDE — it's part of my current job. I do have a few small personal projects, but I built them for myself — nothing especially useful to anyone else. So here you'll find KDE and one story that matters to me.

cat.title: Leo.
cat.body: This is my cat. He moved to Saint Petersburg with me and bravely got through it — now we're both at home here. Leo is convinced my desk is, first and foremost, his workplace, and I don't argue.

cook.title: Lasagna — my signature dish.
cook.body: Cooking calms me down. I can spend hours in the kitchen and come out rested rather than tired — my head clears, and there's something to eat at the end. My signature dish is lasagna, and I make it excellently.

cards.title: Postcards and photographs.
cards.body: I collect beautiful postcards from different cities and countries — some I bring back myself, others I ask friends to bring. Bit by bit it adds up to my own personal world map. Recently I've started shooting on a Papershoot and printing photos sometimes — so my own cities are joining the foreign ones.
cards.note: // if you're travelling somewhere — drop me a line

head.pre: I'm not actively job hunting right now, but

contacts.desc: Talk about an interesting project, chat about Qt, QML, or good UI — or just say hi. Any reason works.
